clues: I built something enormous when it had never rained.
My family and a lot of animals came with me.
God set a bow in the sky for me.
fact: God’s promise never to flood the earth again was one-sided — Noah promised nothing.

clues: I was the youngest in my family.
I looked after sheep before I looked after a kingdom.
I beat a giant with a sling.
fact: David refused the king’s armour because he could not move in it.

clues: I was queen, but I was not born royal.
I hid who my people were.
I said: if I perish, I perish.
fact: The book of Esther never once mentions God by name.

clues: I was thrown into a pit by my own brothers.
I ended up running a country.
I told them: you meant it for evil, God meant it for good.
fact: Almost nothing miraculous happens in Joseph’s story — the pattern is the point.

clues: I was afraid to speak in public.
I met God in a bush that would not burn up.
I led a nation through a sea.
fact: Moses argued with God about the job five separate times.

clues: I kept praying with my windows open.
It had just been made illegal.
I spent a night with lions.
fact: Daniel did not protest or hide — he simply carried on as before.

clues: I said I would never leave.
I was not born one of God’s people.
I became the great-grandmother of a king.
fact: Ruth was a Moabite — an outsider in the line that leads to David and to Jesus.

clues: I ran the wrong way.
A storm found me anyway.
I was angry when God forgave my enemies.
fact: Jonah ran because he suspected success, not failure.
